1.

The case of the petitioner is that he was granted license to open a buffalo meat shop by the Food
Safety and Standards Authority of India vide license dated 18.07.2025, which is valid till 17.07.2026.

entities.text:
Food
Safety and Standards Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
After obtaining the license and after completing all the required formalities, it is the case of the petitioner that she want to inaugurate her meat shop but prevented by respondent nos. 2 & 3 i.e.
Superintendent of Police, Maharajganj and Station House Officer, Police Station Kothibhar, District Maharajganj, respectively.
He has also pointed out that two representations are being made, which are annexures 2 & 3.
These representations are still not being decided.

2. Under the circumstances, the petition is disposed of with a direction to respondent no. 2 to decide the representations of the petitioner, within a period of twenty days from the date on which the certified copy of this order is placed before him.
3. Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of.
